title: Why Does Your Foot FLIP When You Draw a 6? 🦶
description:
Sit down, circle your right foot clockwise, and draw a 6 in the air with your right hand: your foot flips round and follows the 6. Your right hand and right foot take their orders from the same side of your brain (the left side), and a hand and a foot on the same side like to move the same way. Scientists have measured it since 1982: ask people to move them in opposite directions and the movement slips back to the same way all by itself. Exactly why is still argued about. Try the 6 with your LEFT hand: it's easier. And in one 2023 study, people were slower at the opposite-way version even when they only imagined it. Did your foot flip? Yes or no?
